changeSet.author: loco-place
changeSet.comment: Retain pseudonymous first-order referral eligibility after account deletion.
changeSet.sql:
alter table referral_eligibility_marker add constraint ck_referral_eligibility_marker_provider check (provider in ('GOOGLE', 'APPLE', 'TELEGRAM')), add constraint ck_referral_eligibility_marker_digest check (identity_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), add constraint ck_referral_eligibility_marker_scope check (scope = 'CLEANING_FIRST_ORDER_REFERRAL'), add constraint ck_referral_eligibility_marker_expiry check (expires_at > created_at);
alter table referral_reward drop constraint ck_referral_reward_status; alter table referral_reward add constraint ck_referral_reward_status check (status in ('AVAILABLE', 'RESERVED', 'REDEEMED', 'REVOKED')), add constraint ck_referral_reward_revocation check ( (status = 'REVOKED' and revoked_at is not null and reserved_order_id is null) or (status <> 'REVOKED' and revoked_at is null) );
